newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA BONDS STEADY AT LOWS, RAND WEAK ON CROSSES.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA BONDS STEADY AT LOWS, RAND WEAK ON CROSSES.

text.p: 1010 GMT - Bonds lower in quiet midday dealings after bouncing off support during morning. Rand range-trading, firm on dollar, struggling against crosses.

* Key R150 bond at 14.96 pct from 14.915 late on Friday after flirting with key psychological level at 15.00 pct. Dealers say plenty institutional support at big figure while longs happy to constrain upside to 14.99. Low volume exacerbating volatility. Bonds to bounce around in range of 15.00-14.90 pct in afternoon.

* Rand last at 4.4610/4640 against ailing dollar from 4.4620/4650 late on Friday but weaker against crosses. Against German mark hits three month low. Dealers say potential for rand to tend to upside vs dlr over afternoon with range of 4.4650/4575 seen.
